author: 4 Ever Green
description:
Looking for the world’s most beautiful fish you can actually own? In this video, we cover stunning aquarium fish from freshwater and saltwater, plus the basics you must know before buying: tank size, temperament, difficulty level, and what they eat.
Whether you’re building a small tank or a large show aquarium, this list will help you choose fish that look unreal—but can be kept at home with the right setup.
title: World's Most Beautiful Fish That You Can Actually Own
